The subject of the transaction is also assumed to be "Additional payment for iPhone" and "Fee for iPhone payment" respectively. The actual subject should be used instead. 

The recipient's IBAN is not provided in the prompt, so it is assumed to be "Apple" for simplicity. The actual IBAN should be used instead.
